name: In Search of Menara Voidrender

meta.next: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe

summary: Zevrost sends warlocks from Orgrimmar to find Menara Voidrender in the Barrens. He fears fel magic will enslave them, yet directs them to a mentor who can help shape powerful arcane vestments.

sections.title: Warnings in the Shadows
sections.body: Beneath Orgrimmar, warlocks gather in the Cleft of Shadow, where others tolerate them uneasily. Zevrost, one of their bitter tutors, scorns acolytes who seek mastery of the dark arts. He believes each step deeper into fel magic brings them closer to enslavement. To Zevrost, demonic addiction will claim every practitioner in time. Even the most disciplined scholar will become a thrall of the Twisting Nether.

sections.title: The Path to Ratchet
sections.body: Zevrost knows that other warlocks see a different path. Word has reached Orgrimmar of Menara Voidrender, a skilled warlock on the bluffs above Ratchet, the neutral goblin port. Menara seeks promising disciples to help craft special implements for their arcane might. For warlocks eager to advance their craft, her summons begins the making of the legendary Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Fellowship
sections.body: Menara waits high above Ratchet, where warlocks face the hard truths of their order. They must set aside racial and cultural rivalries and support one another. The demons they bargain with show neither prejudice nor mercy to anyone who falters. Sharing knowledge and crafting protective vestments is practical, not charitable. Warlocks need both to survive the hostile beings they bind to their service.

aliases: who starts in search of menara voidrender
faq.answer: Zevrost is an orc warlock trainer in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He distrusts the pursuit of fel power and believes ambitious warlocks are bound for slavery to demonic corruption.
Menara Voidrender is an accomplished warlock in the Barrens, on the cliffs overlooking Ratchet. She mentors rising warlocks and helps them gather rare reagents for potent ceremonial robes.

faq.q: Why does Zevrost think all warlocks are fools?
faq.answer: Zevrost believes fel magic inevitably corrupts and enslaves anyone who tries to master it. He thinks no practitioner can resist addiction, and that seeking greater power only hastens their downfall.

faq.q: Where can Menara Voidrender be found?
faq.answer: Menara Voidrender can be found in the Barrens, on the high hills overlooking Ratchet. Warlocks travel east across the arid savannah to reach her camp above the port.

faq.q: Why do warlocks from different races work together?
faq.answer: Demons summoned by warlocks show cruel malice to anyone who fails to control them. Survival depends on precision, so warlocks share knowledge and tools across cultural boundaries.

faq.q: What happens after finding Menara Voidrender?
faq.answer: After finding Menara Voidrender, a warlock gathers exotic, potent materials from across Azeroth to make the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe, a garment that protects against fel energies.

angles.text: As a warlock, you follow Menara Voidrender's guidance and gather what you need to make your own iconic Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe, a rite of passage for Horde warlocks.
As a Horde warlock, you face contempt from traditional shamans and warriors. You find shelter in hidden places such as Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow or on neutral ground near Ratchet.
